opportunities.point: Management stated that the 26% volume growth for this year continues to be sustainable.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Firstly, we believe that 26% volume growth for this year continues to be sustainable and will benefit from having our expanded capacity available in H2." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management believes that post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 per ton should be sustainable.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Secondly, looking at our overall long-term portfolio and capacity mix and the additional traction with exports and improving operating leverage, we believe post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 per ton should be..." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The board approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized magnet winding wires manufacturing capacity, increasing total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The board has approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized Magnet Winding Wires manufacturing capacity, and which is expected to increase the company's total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance the Phase-3 expansion, which includes purchasing an additional 10 acres of land in Supa.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance this expansion, which also includes he purchase of an additional 10 acres of land in Supa and it will be funded with a combination of internal accruals and long-term debt." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 19.7% earnings growth vs 50% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: Management stated that they see sustained growth and investments across power generation, transmission, and related equipment.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We see sustained growth and investments across power generation, transmission and related equipment driven by grid infrastructure development, renewable energy integration, electrification and growth, electricity requirements from industrial and digital..." opportunities.point: Management noted that specialized magnet winding wires revenue grew 87% year-over-year during Q2, driven largely by exports.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Specialized Magnet Winding Wires revenue overall grew at 87% year-over-year during Q2, with much of that growth driven by exports." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Total installed capacity as on September 30, 2026, was 57,845 metric tons.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our installed capacity as on September 30th, 2026 was 57,845 metric tons, which includes 96% of the total capacity expansion planned at Supa." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The third point being an increase in consolidated utilization rates to 76% in Q2 of FY '27 versus 73% in Q1 of FY '27 based on available capacity for the quarter." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated an objective to return exports to its historical average of around 40% of total revenue over the next few years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "We said that our objective over the next few years is to return exports to its historical average of around 40% of total revenue." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01) [next few years]

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 110 -> 148 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow -9 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -65 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted that due to disturbances in the Middle East, transit times have increased significantly.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Yes. So, as far as the business in Middle East is concerned, we have not seen a significant drop in the business from Middle East, though, because of the disturbance, the transit times have increased significantly as compared to earlier times." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Dec) are still in the cycle.
